home.pressToRecord: Press {{hotkey}} to start a new recording
about.title: About
about.welcomeDescription: Welcome to VoxFusion - a modern desktop application built with SolidJS and Tauri.
about.navigationDescription: This application demonstrates page navigation and routing functionality.
settings.title: Settings
settings.microphoneDescription: Select the microphone to use for voice recording.
settings.muteMediaWhileRecordingDescript: Temporarily mute system audio while recording and restore it afterward.
settings.muffleMediaWhileRecordingDescri: Make other apps sound muffled while recording, like music from the next room, and restore them afterward.
settings.recordingSoundsDescription: Play sounds when recording starts, text is inserted, or an error occurs.
settings.analyticsDescription: Share anonymous usage events to help improve VoxFusion. Changes apply immediately.
settings.analyticsNote: Only event metadata is collected — never your audio, never your transcribed text.
settings.hotkeyDescription: Press this key combination to start or stop recording.
settings.holdToSpeakHotkeyDescription: Hold this key combination to record, then release it to stop.
settings.modelsDescription: Choose the speech-to-text model used for transcription. Download additional models to switch between them.
settings.modelResumeNote: The download will resume from where it left off.
settings.modelExperimentalNote: On-device transcription with this model is experimental and not yet available.
transcriptionList.useCommandToRecord: Use {{hotkey}} to start recording and create your first transcription
style.defaultStyleDescription: Used everywhere except for apps or sites configured on the other tabs. Switch between styles to preview what each one does.
style.perSiteDescription: When you're focused on a browser tab, this style overrides the per-app and default style.
style.perSiteEmptyStateDescription: Add a domain or capture the current browser tab, then pick a style for it.
style.descriptions.professional: Formal business communication. Complete sentences, precise grammar and punctuation, no slang or contractions. Best for email, documents, reports, and formal messaging.
style.descriptions.casual: Conversational tone with contractions and everyday vocabulary. Sparse punctuation, lowercase throughout. Best for chat apps, personal notes, and quick messages.
style.descriptions.agents: Technical instructions for coding agents. Imperative voice, software engineering vocabulary, file paths and identifiers preserved. Best for prompting Claude Code, Cursor, and similar tools.
style.descriptions.default: Clean dictation with standard sentence structure, accurate punctuation, and proper capitalization. No specific tone applied — a neutral baseline.
appInstructions.description: Apps listed here override the default style above.
appInstructions.emptyStateDescription: Search above to add an app and choose a transcription style for it.
dictionary.description: Add custom words for better transcription accuracy
dictionary.emptyStateDescription: Add words to improve transcription accuracy for specialized terms, names, or phrases you use often.
dictionary.perAppDescription: When an app is focused, its words are used alongside the default dictionary above.
dictionary.perAppEmptyStateDescription: Search above to add an app, then expand it to add custom words for that app.
dictionary.sitesDescription: When you're focused on a browser tab, that site's words are used alongside the default dictionary.
dictionary.sitesEmptyStateDescription: Add a domain or capture the current browser tab, then expand it to add custom words for that site.
onboarding.microphoneDescription: Choose which microphone VoxFusion should use for voice recording. You can change this later in Settings.
onboarding.hotkeyDescription: Set a hands-free shortcut and an optional hold-to-speak shortcut for quick dictation.
onboarding.completionDescription: VoxFusion is ready to help you with voice transcription.
onboarding.micPermissionDescription: VoxFusion needs access to your microphone to record and transcribe your voice.
onboarding.micPermissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Enable VoxFusion in System Settings under Privacy & Security → Microphone — this step continues automatically once access is granted.
onboarding.accessibilityDescription: VoxFusion needs accessibility access to type transcribed text into any application.
onboarding.accessibilityInstructions: Click the lock icon to make changes, then check VoxFusion in the list.
onboarding.keyboardAccessDescription: VoxFusion listens to the keyboard for its hotkeys while you work in other apps.
onboarding.keyboardAccessInstructions: On Wayland, VoxFusion reads the keyboard devices. Add yourself to the input group with sudo usermod -aG input $USER, then log out and back in.
onboarding.learningDescription: Test the voice-to-text flow before you start.
onboarding.learningHoldToSpeakSuffix: while speaking, then release to stop
onboarding.modelDownloadDescription: Download the Whisper V3 Large Turbo model for local, offline transcription.
onboarding.modelDownloadNote: This model enables offline transcription. Download requires internet connection.
onboarding.privacyDescription: VoxFusion can send anonymous usage events — things like which features are used and the app version. Metadata only: your audio and transcribed text never leave your device. You can change this anytime in Settings → Privacy.
onboarding.privacyToggleDescription: Metadata only — never audio, never transcriptions.
